datasets.name: ds_daily
queryLines:
SELECT usage_date, component, resource, product, sku, attribution, cost_type, run_ref, dbu, list_usd
FROM cost_attribution_daily

columns.description: Generation, grounding and unlabelled LLM share of list cost
columns.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN `component` IN ('Generation LLM', 'Grounding digests (ai_summarize)', 'Unlabelled LLM calls (chat + judge)') THEN `list_usd` ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(`list_usd`), 0)

datasets.name: ds_cpa
queryLines:
SELECT usage_date, appeals_generated, fully_loaded_usd, variable_usd, fixed_usd, generation_llm_usd,
fully_loaded_per_appeal_usd, variable_per_appeal_usd, llm_per_appeal_usd
FROM cost_per_appeal_daily

columns.description: Cost on days with generated appeals / appeals generated
Variable cost on days with generated appeals / appeals generated

datasets.name: ds_volume
queryLines:
SELECT appeals_per_day, fixed_own_usd_per_day, fixed_shared_vs_usd_per_day,
fixed_own_usd_per_appeal, fixed_shared_vs_usd_per_appeal, variable_usd_per_appeal,
total_own_usd_per_appeal, total_incl_shared_vs_usd_per_appeal, variable_usd_per_day,
total_incl_shared_vs_usd_per_day
FROM cost_at_volume
ORDER BY appeals_per_day

datasets.name: ds_run_rate
datasets.displayName: Fully loaded per appeal at 180 per day
queryLines:
SELECT appeals_per_day, total_incl_shared_vs_usd_per_appeal
FROM cost_at_volume
WHERE appeals_per_day = 180

datasets.name: ds_pipelines
queryLines:
SELECT usage_date, component, resource, run_ref, dbu, list_usd
FROM cost_attribution_daily
WHERE component IN ('Job compute', 'SDP pipeline', 'Lakebase sync pipeline', 'Warehouse SQL (job statements)')
ORDER BY usage_date, component

datasets.name: ds_agents
queryLines:
SELECT usage_date, component, attribution, cost_type, dbu, list_usd
FROM cost_attribution_daily
WHERE component IN ('Chat endpoint (always-on)', 'Unlabelled LLM calls (chat + judge)', 'Genie space (Agent)')
ORDER BY usage_date, component

datasets.name: ds_fixed
queryLines:
SELECT usage_date, component, resource, attribution, dbu, list_usd
FROM cost_attribution_daily
WHERE component IN ('App', 'Lakebase compute + storage', 'Vector Search endpoint (shared)')
ORDER BY usage_date, component

lines: ## Method: how this cost is measured

### Sources Cost is system.billing.usage for this workspace only (workspace_id 7474656043998914), joined to system.billing.list_prices on SKU and usage start time (effective list price). List price only: no discounts, no committed-use rates. Logic lives in the UC view cost_attribution_daily; the dashboard and the evidence read the same view.

### Direct vs allocated **Direct**: the billing record carries a build-owned ID: job_id, pipeline id, app_name, serving endpoint name, Lakebase project id, Genie agent_id, or a foundation-model call tagged with the build's warehouse. **Allocated**: a shared resource. Warehouse 559faf81 is shared and uptime-billed, so only job-attributed statement minutes are charged to the build (system.query.history job_info), at 24 DBU/h for Medium serverless, the COST_2B rule. Idle uptime and other users' statements stay unallocated. The Vector Search endpoint appeals-vs-endpoint is shared with an earlier build; 100% of its uptime from 2026-11-24 is shown, which is an upper bound.

### Variable vs fixed **Variable** scales with appeals: generation LLM, grounding digests, job compute, job warehouse share, SDP and Lakebase sync pipelines. **Fixed** is always-on uptime: app, chat endpoint, Lakebase compute and storage, shared VS endpoint. **Other** is Genie per-question usage and unlabelled LLM calls (chat per-request tokens and the judge, which carry no caller tag). Other is in fully loaded, not in variable.

### Billing lag and date range Complete through 2026-11-25 (UTC). 2026-11-26 is partial: billing ran to 05:30 UTC, so its fixed cost is under-counted until billing closes. Billing usage can lag a few hours. Appeals per day come from appeals_output.generated_at, the current table state. The 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25 generations were overwritten by a clean-state rerun, so those days show cost with no appeals in the table. Delta history shows 180 appeals inserted on each of the three days.

### What is excluded Other builds on this workspace: their endpoints, apps, jobs, Genie spaces, Lakebase projects and Vector Search indexes. Genie Code and GENIE_ONE usage. Other warehouses and their statements. ai_parse_document calls. Networking, storage and predictive-optimization usage. Free-tier Genie usage is $0 at list.

### How to read cost per appeal Fixed cost does not scale with volume, so cost per appeal falls as volume rises. Variable cost per appeal is roughly constant. Use the Cost at your volume table to see fully loaded cost at 60, 150, 180, 300 and 600 appeals a day. Treat the measured per-day figures as the audit trail, not as production sizing. Production volumes, contracted rates and the health system's own tenancy will change the fixed base.

### Cross-check with COST_2B docs/business_case/COST_2B.md measured $0.069 LLM per appeal, about $0.11 variable and about $0.51 fully loaded at 60 appeals a day. This view reproduces the LLM figure exactly ($0.069 on 2026-11-26) and gives about $0.10 variable and about $0.52 fully loaded at 60 per day with own resources. Differences: grounding digests were fully cached on 2026-11-26 (zero cost; COST_2B ran a cold cache), and the warehouse share is measured from job statements, not estimated.
